label: Week 6
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-14T01:08Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Wednesday of Week 6, stamped vibe week reg-6. Volume landed for all 32 clubs. Loudest rooms by volume: HOU, NE, BUF, DAL, CHI, DEN, SF, CLE, SEA, ARI. HOU volume (~14k) is heavily inflated by #WeAreTexans / Texas noise in the count_query; NYJ and NE counts also include non-NFL #Jets/#Patriots bleed. CIN quiet after filter (pool was soccer/college/other clubs). Dropped mostly college football (Notre Dame-BYU, Red River/Arch Manning, Penn State recruiting pitch, Kentucky-Oklahoma, Colorado/Deion, Coastal/Kentucky uniforms, Alabama-Georgia, Vols QB), MLB/NBA/NHL/F1/NASCAR/MLS/eNASCAR, Hallmark Bears film, Hulu Browns drama, male cheerleader clip, Mevis Instagram scrutiny, Trump game-attendance rumor, Kordell Stewart HBO nostalgia, dating-rival fans thread, Madden TOTW card, Big Dom politics fundraiser, and heavy cross-club near-dupes (power rankings, fraud meter, undefeated schedules).

items.title: Fans launch Billboards, #BidwillOut push
items.one_line: Cardinals fans pooled ~$4k for Phoenix billboards screaming SELL THE TEAM / #BIDWILLOUT after a 1-4 start and a workplace discrimination lawsuit headed to NFL arbitration.

items.title: Beck stays inactive until late November
items.one_line: LaFleur will keep rookie Carson Beck as the emergency third QB behind Jacoby Brissett; ESPN's Graziano says a real evaluation likely waits until after a brutal six-game stretch.

items.title: LaFleur wants Jeremiyah Love blocking more
items.one_line: Coach said shaky pass protection has kept the No. 3 overall pick in five-man sets as a blocker, limiting routes despite receiving upside.

items.title: Penix expects to start vs. Bears
items.one_line: After rib injury and Tua entering late in the OT loss to Baltimore, Stefanski expects Michael Penix Jr. to start Sunday; imaging was positive and he took full first-team reps.

items.title: Bijan leads NFL at 580 rushing yards
items.one_line: Bijan Robinson leads the league with 580 yards through Week 5, fueling Robinson-vs-Gibbs top-back talk heading into the Bears game.

items.title: Jackson, Lane returns eyed for Browns
items.one_line: League source: Lamar (ankle) has a realistic shot Sunday; Ja'Kobi Lane's 21-day window is open after a full practice, with Moore/Guillory released to make room. Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens also back.

items.title: Fans defend Crosby-to-Hendrickson pivot
items.one_line: Ravens nearly traded two firsts for Maxx Crosby, backed out on knee concerns, signed Hendrickson and drafted Vega Ioane — fans argue the package beats Crosby's early sack pace after the 4-1 start.

items.title: Huntley OT rally past Falcons still echoing
items.one_line: Backup threw for 201 and scored the OT sneak; Hamilton's pick of Tua sealed 30-23 as Baltimore sits 4-1 atop the North.

items.title: Allen's 121-rush OT win still loud
items.one_line: Josh Allen threw for 210 and ran for 121 in a 37-34 OT win at the Rams (first career OT win), Bills 4-1; dual-threat MVP talk and media-coverage debates dominate the room.

items.title: Waive CB Kendall, bring back Danna
items.one_line: Buffalo waived practice-squad elevate Anthony Kendall (38% snaps vs. Rams) and re-signed OLB Mike Danna; Dee Alford expected back vs. Raiders.

items.title: Leonhard demands defensive fixes
items.one_line: DC Jim Leonhard after the OT win: defense is 30th in yards and 28th in points, '1 out of 5 showing up,' and he'll review schemes before the Raiders game.

items.title: Bryce Young topping early QB grades
items.one_line: Through four games Young leads PFF at 88.6 and yards/game at 317 (9 TD, 2 INT); Rapoport called his step-up as big as anyone expected ahead of the Eagles.

items.title: Rested Panthers host jet-lagged Eagles
items.one_line: Carolina (2-2, off bye) faces Philly (2-3) returning from London; rare rested-vs-international-traveler spot historically 4-0 for the road team.

items.title: Caleb Williams on track for Falcons
items.one_line: Grade 2 hamstring sidelined him three games; Rapoport and Ben Johnson say he's close after full walk-through reps, with a good chance to start Sunday in Atlanta.

items.title: Williams John Wick IG return flex
items.one_line: Williams swapped his Instagram to a John Wick look and 'I'm Inevitable' as the return timeline lined up with the three-to-four-week hamstring plan.

items.title: Love's 367-yard rout still stings
items.one_line: Packers crushed Bears 31-7 on Oct 11; Love 25-of-31 for 367 and two scores with a 94.5 PFF grade, amplifying urgency around Williams' return.

items.title: Sign RB Estime; Sanders to IR
items.one_line: Browns claimed Audric Estime off Minnesota's PS and put Raheim Sanders on IR (hip, 4+ weeks); also added TE Devin Culp and G Vershon Lee to the PS ahead of Baltimore.

items.title: Dylan Sampson designated for return
items.one_line: Second-year RB opened a 21-day IR window; Monken said there's a chance he plays vs. the Ravens if practice goes well amid a thin backfield.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders signs first NFL agent
items.one_line: Sitting behind Watson with one snap this year, Sanders joined Young Money APAA Sports; Browns say they still plan to develop him, but trade chatter rose with the timing.

items.title: Hire Mike Pettine as senior D assistant
items.one_line: Dallas added Pettine to support first-year DC Christian Parker after a 2-3 start and 31st-ranked yards allowed; Parker may call from the booth.

items.title: Schottenheimer clarifies Parker's role
items.one_line: HC said no final call yet on booth vs. sideline despite Jerry Jones comments, and affirmed backing for Parker ahead of Green Bay.

items.title: Bland back; Porter Jr. eyes full snaps
items.one_line: DaRon Bland returned from illness; Joey Porter Jr. (ankle tweak, limited Wednesday) expects no snap count at Lambeau after a limited debut and a missed home game.

items.title: Hufanga out 2–3 weeks (ankle)
items.one_line: Safety Talanoa Hufanga is out multiple weeks; secondary already missing PS2 with Riley Moss questionable (ribs) for TNF vs. Seattle.

items.title: TNF injury board vs. Seahawks
items.one_line: Both 3-2 clubs limp into Empower Field: Denver without Surtain/Hufanga; Seattle's JSN limited (ankle) but plans to play, Charbonnet out.

items.title: Kareem Jackson retires as a Bronco
items.one_line: Signed a one-day deal to end his 15-year career in orange and blue; will plant the alumni flag Thursday before the Seahawks game.

items.title: Goff turns 32 with elite zero-INT start
items.one_line: Through five games: 1,485 yards, 12 TD, 0 INT, 111.3 rating; Lions 3-2 after the 45-21 Cardinals rout, on bye this week.

items.title: Lions O-line tops PFF after Week 5
items.one_line: Detroit claimed PFF's No. 1 offensive line spot after allowing just three pressures in Week 5 and fueling the 45-point explosion.

items.title: Injury crunch before Cowboys SNF
items.one_line: Wednesday DNP: Keisean Nixon (groin), Benjamin St-Juste (hamstring), Skyy Moore (ankle); Javon Hargrave headed to IR (torn Achilles). Banks limited; Jordon Riley practiced first time since Achilles tear.

items.title: Parsons explains cautious ACL timeline
items.one_line: Still on PUP after Dec 2025 ACL/meniscus surgery; told his podcast he's game-ready but waiting to fix root issues so he won't overcompensate — misses the Cowboys rematch.

items.title: Love's 367-yard Bears torch still buzzing
items.one_line: 25-of-31, 367, 2 TD, 0 INT vs. Chicago; third in passing yards through five with 1,408/10 TD ahead of Dallas at Lambeau.

items.title: Trade for Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.one_line: Texans sent 2027 2nd+7th to Arizona for MHJ and a 6th; reunites with C.J. Stroud. Practiced sharp and will debut Sunday in London vs. Jacksonville in a limited role.

items.title: Activate Braden Smith from IR
items.one_line: OT Braden Smith (partially torn plantar fascia) activated; could challenge Trent Brown at RT. Also signed QB Mark Gronowski and WR Bryce Oliver to PS; Henry To'oTo'o designated for return.

items.title: MHJ London debut confirmed
items.one_line: DeMeco Ryans praised Harrison's seamless practice debut and confirmed he'll play vs. the Jaguars, though not every snap, as Houston tries to climb from 1-4.

items.title: Quenton Nelson drawing trade interest
items.one_line: Eight-time Pro Bowl guard in the final year of his extension; Eagles (post-Lane Johnson) and Vikings among clubs linked as possible destinations for premium picks.

items.title: SNF flex buzz: Jags-Colts as replacement
items.one_line: NFL considering flexing Eagles-Commanders off Nov 1 SNF; Jaguars-Colts emerges as a top replacement option with Philly 2-3 and Washington 1-3-1.

items.title: Fans defend Boerkircher draft pick
items.one_line: Analyst called the second-round TE a reach (44 receiving yards); Jags room points to his run-blocking in Coen's heavier packages amid the 4-1 start.

items.title: BTJ among trade-deadline WR names
items.one_line: Graziano/Fowler listed Brian Thomas Jr. among WRs drawing interest before the Nov 10 deadline as his role has dipped behind teammates.

items.title: Kansas draws STAR Bonds stadium district
items.one_line: New district spanning Wyandotte/Johnson counties will capture sales-tax increments for a ~$3B domed stadium and Olathe HQ/practice facility.

items.title: Josh Simmons back at limited practice
items.one_line: 2025 first-round LT returned Wednesday after missing the first four games (back); Rashee Rice (hamstring) sat and remains unlikely for the Chargers.

items.title: Jeanty playing through ankle/foot
items.one_line: Internal rest talks for Ashton Jeanty; Kubiak grinned 'He's playing' as the 3-2 Raiders host Buffalo, with the bye not until Week 13.

items.title: Schefter: Herbert trade talk shut down
items.one_line: High-level source: Chargers have never discussed trading Justin Herbert and won't, despite 0-5 start; contract through 2029 with no-trade clause.

items.title: Sign Jake Browning to practice squad
items.one_line: Added Browning after Trey Lance went to IR (groin); joins Herbert and Uiagalelei. Also added WR Luke Grimm to the PS.

items.title: Reports: eye Adam Gase as interim OC
items.one_line: 0-5 offense near bottom in scoring/yards has buzz that Mike McDaniel could be replaced interim by Adam Gase; Harbaugh said to be safe for now ahead of Chiefs.

items.title: Cut Mevis, sign Blake Grupe
items.one_line: Released Harrison Mevis a day after 0-for-2 FGs (50 miss, 48 blocked) in the OT loss to Buffalo; signed Grupe off the Jets' practice squad.

items.title: Alaric Jackson suspension cut to one
items.one_line: Appeal reduced two-game ban to one for punching Bradley Chubb after handshakes; misses only Cardinals, Quessenberry starts at LT.

items.title: Yardage kings still loud after OT loss
items.one_line: Stafford threw for 383 in the 37-34 OT loss; Rams lead NFL in yardage differential since 1976 (139.2/game) ahead of the Cardinals home date.

items.title: Claim WR Jared Wayne; waive Ryan Miller
items.one_line: Bye-week roster shuffle: claimed Wayne off Houston waivers, waived Miller, signed DL Jordan Jefferson to PS, released Mazi Smith.

items.title: Murray 3-0 as starter for 5-0 Vikings
items.one_line: On a one-year deal after Arizona released him: 69/101, 662 yards, 2 TD, 2 INT as starter; Cards sit 1-4 without him (3-28 in last 31 sans Murray).

items.title: Brandt questions Murray playoff ceiling
items.one_line: First Take debate after Murray's 229 pass / 51 rush in the Saints win; fans counter with escape clips and Minnesota's defense.

items.title: NFC North all above .500 again
items.one_line: Vikings 5-0, Bears/Lions/Packers all 3-2 — only division with every team over .500 through five weeks since 2002.

items.title: Patriots surge into top-10 power rankings
items.one_line: Rocketed from ~31st to as high as 10th after wins over Bills and Raiders; Drake Maye's yardage games fueled the climb at 3-2.

items.title: Gayle Benson: 1-4 start unacceptable
items.one_line: Owner publicly put Moore, Loomis, and players on notice after three straight home losses, vowing accountability ahead of Giants and Paris vs. Steelers.

items.title: Release Jayden Price after kickoff fumble
items.one_line: Waived CB after costly second-half kickoff fumble in the 23-13 Vikings loss; also cut Brock Rechsteiner, Cal Adomitis, and re-signed Decamerion Richardson.

items.title: NFL confirms Steelers-Saints in Paris
items.one_line: Oct 25 at Stade de France is on despite French education protests; league cites security coordination with local partners.

items.title: Injury report: Carter calf tops list
items.one_line: DNPs include Abdul Carter (calf), Andrew Thomas (groin), Jermaine Eluemunor (calf), Tyler Nubin (neck), Colton Hood (concussion) ahead of Saints at MetLife.

items.title: Winston reframes 'Experience' ahead of Saints
items.one_line: Starting vs. his former club, Jameis leaned on faith language and daily 1% growth in a signature presser that the league account amplified.

items.title: OT tie with Commanders still debated
items.one_line: Daniels' late OT scramble/sack that ran out the clock (27-27) keeps NFC East finger-pointing alive; Giants sit 3-1-1.

items.title: Work out Matthew Judon
items.one_line: Hosted 34-year-old edge (72 career sacks) Tuesday with Ossai nursing an ankle; also hosted Quinton Bell and Cam Sample, then signed Bell to the PS ahead of Patriots.

items.title: Garrett Wilson trade speculation rises
items.one_line: 31/374/3 through five with elite separation grades; 49ers WR injuries fueled rumor chatter, but Jets fans cite the $130M extension's dead-cap hit.

items.title: David Bailey leading DROY buzz
items.one_line: Three sacks and seven tackles in the 17-12 Browns win put the Jets rookie atop Pepsi ROTW and DROY odds after five season sacks.

items.title: Open windows for Dickerson and three more
items.one_line: 21-day windows for Landon Dickerson, TEs Calcaterra/Stowers, and DB Jakorian Bennett; Dickerson was active at practice. Barkley (hamstring) missed media portion.

items.title: Wednesday report lists 24 names
items.one_line: Barkley and DeVonta Smith missed again; Hurts practiced fully and is set to start vs. Carolina. Eleven limited, seven full.

items.title: Dead last in second-half yards/game
items.one_line: Ari Meirov chart: Eagles at 99.4 second-half yards per game (32nd), trailing even Miami, as the 2-3 club returns from London to face rested Carolina.

items.title: Paris game vs. Saints confirmed
items.one_line: NFL says Steelers-Saints on Oct 25 at Stade de France is proceeding amid French protests, with security coordination ongoing.

items.title: Germie Bernard career-high vs. Colts
items.one_line: Rookie WR: six catches, 80 yards, nine targets after early drop; waiver-wire darling with 13/140 through five as Pittsburgh leans pass-heavy.

items.title: Tomlin: players-only meetings mean you're dead
items.one_line: On New Heights, Tomlin said closed-door players-only meetings are a last resort and a bad sign — comments landing after Dallas's defense held one.

items.title: TNF injury board at Denver
items.one_line: JSN limited (ankle) but plans to play vs. Denver's depleted secondary; Zach Charbonnet out. Broncos missing Surtain and Hufanga.

items.title: 32-29 loss to 49ers still fueling rivalry talk
items.one_line: Purdy's late TD to Cooks and Pineiro's kick kept SF perfect; Seahawks room points to turnovers/injuries and two more meetings this year.

items.title: 49ers No. 1 in power rankings at 5-0
items.one_line: Top CBS/Kalshi lists after edging Seattle 32-29; 10-point favorites vs. Commanders on MNF Oct 19 at Levi's.

items.title: Eye WR help with Deebo sidelined
items.one_line: Hamstring has Deebo out weeks; names like McLaurin, Jeudy, BTJ, Garrett Wilson, and a Jennings reunion floating before the Nov 10 deadline.

items.title: Purdy late drives beat Seahawks 32-29
items.one_line: Survived seven turnovers and an ejection; Purdy 19/29, 189, 2 TD as SF capitalized on Seattle's four turnovers to stay atop the West.

items.title: Mayfield tests injured thumb at practice
items.one_line: Out two games after Week 3 dislocation; plans to throw Wednesday. Bowles: must be fully healthy or he sits — no emergency backup role. Daniels has started in his place.

items.title: 0-5 sting: Tate and Ward push back
items.one_line: Rookie Carnell Tate after the 26-3 Texans loss: 'I ain't ever lose like this'; Ward rejected a 'used to losing' question — 'No, I'm not a loser' — as Saleh affirms he stays the starter vs. Colts.

items.title: Ward stats under microscope at 0-5
items.one_line: 23/36, 170 yards, INT, four sacks in the Houston rout; Titans NFL-low 58 points through five with Ward at 896/3/3 and a 77.2 rating.

items.title: Slump since Vrabel firing still debated
items.one_line: 6-33 since Amy Adams Strunk fired Vrabel in Jan 2024; 0-5 under Saleh with the league's worst offense (~11.6 PPG) as Vrabel thrives in New England.

items.title: Daniels OT clock blunder still loud
items.one_line: With eight seconds at the Giants' 24, Daniels took a sack instead of spiking for a FG; 27-27 tie left Washington 1-3-1. Parsons blamed Daniels; Quinn and Daniels both owned it.

items.title: SNF flex threat for Eagles-Commanders
items.one_line: NFL may pull the Nov 1 NBC game after slow starts; decision window to Oct 20 with Commanders visiting undefeated 49ers this week.
